text:
liam: Heads-up — onboarding hit a weird SDK vs REST parity problem: auto-pager stops and later calls get 401.
erin: Can you share minimal repro (sdk snippet + curl)?
liam: repro in sampleapp: `routes = client.routes.list(limit=100); for r in routes.auto_paginate(): process(r)`
liam: curl that works: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/routes?limit=100&cursor=page_2\"` returns 200 + header `x-next-cursor: page_3`. SDK is only checking `body.next_cursor`.
pat: Wait, didn't we migrate to `meta.next_cursor` in the body last year?
liam: That's the issue — hosted uses header `x-next-cursor`, private uses `meta.next_cursor`, legacy had `next_cursor` at top-level. SDK only handles top-level and meta, not headers.
erin: Oof. Also saw auth-refresh mismatch: server sometimes sends `x-rotate-ephemeral` and SDK expects `x-auth-refresh`.
aj: Two separate incompatibilities: pagination location (header vs body) and auth-refresh header name. Both break long-running pagers and credential rotation.
liam: Logs show "no next_cursor found, ending pagination" then later "401 token invalid" when trying to fetch more pages.
pat: Proposed quick normalization: pager should check `resp.meta?.next_cursor`, `resp.next_cursor`, then `resp.headers['x-next-cursor']` (in that order) and unify into a single cursor variable.
erin: And auth middleware should treat both `x-auth-refresh` and `x-rotate-ephemeral` as triggers and attempt a refresh when truthy.
liam: Also add defensive guards: if cursor is falsy, do not attempt a followup; surface debug metric about unknown pagination shapes.
aj: Let's add unit tests covering three shapes: header-only cursor, meta body cursor, top-level cursor. Also tests for both header names for auth refresh.
erin: CI should run a tiny compatibility matrix in the sdk pipeline: hosted vs private vs legacy shapes mocked.
liam: I pushed WIP branch `fix/python-sdk-pager-interop` with two failing tests. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-python/pull/1002
devex-bot: CI for sdk-python/pull/1002 failed on `pytest -k pagination` — AssertionError: expected pager to call next_page 3 times but called 1.
pat: In the test harness the fake Response didn't map headers into the `.headers` property the adapter uses. Add adapter layer in tests to set response.headers properly.
aj: Also audit other list_* endpoints (models, keys, deployments) for the same drift — likely change was rolled out inconsistently.
erin: After fix, update quickstart and onboarding sample to show how SDK normalizes pagination and mention auth header compatibility in changelog.
liam: I'll add a debug log when SDK sees an unknown pagination key so we can triage future drifts quickly.
pat: Small note: add a null-check before destructuring `resp.meta` — tests showed `TypeError` when response was undefined in some mocked paths.
liam: Will push test fixes and the normalization patch later today. I'll report back here once CI is green. :rocket:
